author: fidjissimo
text: Thank you for the honor of naming me Executive of the Year, @SFBusinessTimes! It’s been a fun year at Instacart. We’re cooking!

quoted.text: Instacart shareholders wouldn't want to pick a replacement for Fidji Simo. Here's why the online grocery leader is the San Francisco Business Times' Executive of the Year. https://t.co/lSR5Ce5enS

author: fidjissimo
text: The @tryramp team is simply stellar. I love it when great people and great products win. I had the chance to get a glimpse into how they got here, and they truly earned every bit of their success through profound customer obsession. Happy 5th birthday, @tryramp!

quoted.text:
